title: Scroll views | Apple Developer Documentation - [Look to Scroll](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/scroll-views\#Look-to-Scroll)
claim: Avoid using Look to Scroll for secondary content.** In general, support standard gestures — but not Look to Scroll — in views that contain UI controls or dense information that requires quick, precise scrolling. For example, the Notes app offers Look to Scroll within the main view to let people easily read their content, but doesn’t support it for the list of notes.
